response.sql:
WITH qc_by_funding AS (
  SELECT p.fundflux, COUNT(*) AS qc_count
  FROM scanqc AS q
  JOIN projects AS p ON q.arcref = p.arcregistry
  GROUP BY p.fundflux
)
SELECT fundflux,
       qc_count,
       1.0 * qc_count / SUM(qc_count) OVER () AS fraction_of_total,
       1.0 * qc_count / AVG(qc_count) OVER () AS relative_to_average
FROM qc_by_funding;

assumptions.assumption: SQLite groups all NULL funding sources together as the missing-funding group; the average is across funding-source groups represented among matched QC records.
